newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bel-20 retreats but retains confidence.
newsitem.headline: Bel-20 retreats but retains confidence.

text.p: The Bel-20 index of leading shares pared slender early gains on Wednesday but dealers remained confident it would climb further in the near term on the back of fund-related buying.
"The market remains well supported. There will be further buying to cover click funds," one trader said.
Buying for "click funds", which lock in profits at certain Bel-20 levels, has been one of the index's driving forces in recent months.
At 0905 GMT the Bel-20 was up just 0.05 percent at 2,600.99, after earlier touching 2,614.61.
One dealer said the market was now awaiting the first batch of first-half 1997 company earnings to see whether they were strong enough to help fuel the Bel-20's rise to new record levels.

Chemicals and drugs firm UCB, up 0.3 percent at 140,500 francs, kicks off the earnings season later on Wednesday. Two other Bel-20 heavyweights, chemicals firm Solvay and oil group PetroFina are due to report on Thursday.
